<style>
.plane-wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 2.5rem}
.plane-svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}
.pl-trail{stroke:#CDBB9C;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:var(--len);stroke-dashoffset:var(--len)}
.plane-go .pl-trail{animation:pl-draw 3.4s cubic-bezier(.42,0,.58,1) forwards}
@keyframes pl-draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
.pl-dot{opacity:0;transform-origin:948px 92px;transform:scale(0)}
.plane-go .pl-dot{animation:pl-pop .4s 3.5s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes pl-pop{to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
#pl-plane{opacity:0}
.plane-go #pl-plane{opacity:1}
.plane-still .pl-trail{stroke-dashoffset:0}
.plane-still .pl-dot{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
var w=document.querySelector(".plane-wrap"),p=document.getElementById("pl-path");if(!w||!p)return;
var L=p.getTotalLength();w.style.setProperty("--len",L);
if(matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches){w.classList.add("plane-still");return;}
function go(){w.classList.add("plane-go");document.getElementById("pl-anim").beginElement();}
if("IntersectionObserver" in window){var o=new IntersectionObserver(function(e){if(e[0].isIntersecting){o.disconnect();go();}},{threshold:.6});o.observe(w);}else go();
})();
</script>
